messages.subject: RE: Stratton MSA – revised draft (v3) following yesterday's call
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Thanks for a constructive call. To confirm the landing zone reflected in our revised draft (version 3): liability cap 150% with uncapped carve-outs; uptime 99.8%; UK hosting with EEA sub-processors permitted on safeguards; payment terms 45 days; and termination for convenience for Stratton only, after the initial term, on 180 days' notice.

If Stratton are content with those, I think we're agreed in substance and can move to engrossment. Proposed signing the week of 19 May.

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
